title: Victoria Coleman | EECS at UC Berkeley
content: Victoria Coleman | EECS at UC Berkeley Victoria Coleman: Faculty Home Page Larger Photo Victoria Coleman Professor Associate Provost, Berkeley Air & Space Center Contact Information vcoleman@berkeley.edu Office Hours By appointment Links Publications Research Support Laman Sadaghiani 633 Davis lsadaghiani@berkeley.edu Biography Professor Victoria Coleman received her Ph.D. from the University of Manchester (UK) in 1991. She has held a variety of leadership positions in government and industry, and most recently served as the Director of DARPA and the Chief Scientist for the United States Air Force. Her areas of interest are trusted and assured microelectronics, trusted autonomy, collaborative autonomy, defense innovation, emerging space capabilities and digital human rights.
